node.description: This Meetup group is concerned with data-driven and AI-first finance in general and algorithmic trading in particular. Its events cover the latest developments in the field, presented by experienced practitioners and academics. There is also a focus on Python a technology platform in the financial industry.

node.name: Free Mandarin Chinese Classes for Beginners
node.description:
Nihao! Welcome to our Mandarin Chinese learning community! This group is perfect for anyone interested in learning Mandarin, whether you're just starting out or looking to improve your skills. Most of our classes are designed for beginners, but we also offer intermediate and advanced sessions from time to time.

We typically host virtual meetups once or twice a month, providing interactive and engaging lessons to help you build confidence in speaking, reading, and writing Chinese. In addition, we occasionally organize in-person events in New York, where members can practice Mandarin and meet their peers in a fun and immersive setting.

All our Meetup events are proudly sponsored by **Sishu Mandarin (私塾中文)**, a Chinese language school dedicated to making Mandarin learning accessible, effective, and enjoyable. Join us to connect with fellow language learners, explore Chinese culture, and take your Mandarin skills to the next level!

Visit [www.sishumandarin.com](http://www.sishumandarin.com) for free Chinese learning materials!

node.name: New York Oracle Users Group Meetup
node.description:
NYOUG (New York Oracle User Group) was formed in 1984 for the exchange of ideas, assistance and support among users. We currently have 1000+ users nationally. Our home base is New York.

NYOUG is a group focused on providing industry leading speakers regarding database management (Oracle, Hadoop, MYSQL, etc), application development, mid-tier.

node.name: New York Area Group for Informatics and Modeling (NYAGIM)
node.description:
We are a growing community of greater New York City area scientists focused on the advances of in silico methods related to drug discovery, and how they increasingly impact and transform pharmaceutical research.

Our scientific interest covers a wide range of fields, including computational chemistry, medicinal chemistry, chemoinformatics, machine learning, molecular modeling, structural biology and protein design to cite a few.

NYAGIM is an inclusive forum for all academia and industry scientists interested in this particularly dynamic scientific interface, to connect, interact, learn and share.

We notably organize quarterly events where we gather for scientific seminars and discussions as well as for networking.

node.name: "Qigong NYC (aka Chi Kung) - Energy Health Fitness"
node.description:
Qi gong or Qigong[1] or Chi kung[2] (气功 or prana force) is the philosophy and practice of aligning breath, physical activity and awareness for mental, spiritual and corporeal health, as well as the development of human potential.[3] It includes certain forms of martial arts[4] and the spiritual awakening to one's true nature.[5]
http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Qigong

Anyone Can: It doesn't matter if your are young, old, healthy or ill, Qigong is for everyone.

Qigong is ideal for reducing stress, alleviating chronic pain, and improving overall aging issues.  It is also great for maintaining calmness, staying centered, becoming grounded, and experiencing relaxation anywhere, including the workplace and at home.

Easily: Our Qigong exercises, using a combination of breath coordination, body movements, and mental intentions are simple, easy to learn and effective.

Qigong is a wonderful supplement to other body-mind practices as well as a powerful independent practice.  Qigong exercises includes various of breath-movements that can range from strong and pronounced to calm and unnoticable.  Most exercises can be performed while lying, sitting or standing.  The movements of Qigong and each set of exercises are designed to strengthen and relax certain acupuncture meridians and organ systems.

Experience: Experience new levels of health, energy & relaxation through Qigong.  Qigong brings the yin and yang forces of the body together back into harmony by bringing scattered energy back together.

The result is that you are more relaxed and feel more energized.  By feeling better or great it increases your productivity and focus.

Benefits: The workout that will extend your warranty.

America's Doctor, Dr. Oz, says the ancient Chinese technique of Qigong is a great way tap into our natural energy and, in turn, combat the aging process.

http://www.oprah.com/health/Dr-Oz-in-Using-Qigong-to-Combat-Aging-Video

Qigong exercises are performed to increase and balance the flow of qi or energy throughout the body.  The exercises also promotes the development of balance, coordination, flexibility, strength, and endurance. Coordinated deep breathing with the movements promote relaxation and develops the mind-body connection.  Practice of Qigong leads to the enhancement of physical, mental, and spiritual health.  Qigong also promotes "Natural Energetic Healing" which greatly helps to provide relief from chronic aches and pains, negative emotions, and deficient immune systems.

 

Contact Us: Come explore Qigong-NYC.com Take an individual class or a whole series. No matter what you decide – it will be a step toward aligning and empowering your mind, body and spirit.
www.qigong-nyc.com

If any of you would like to be added to the Qigong NYC newsletter email list, you can send an email to me at:
info@qigong-nyc.com

Check out our about us page to get more information about us.
Or go to http://qigong-nyc.com/
or go to http://gemhypnosis.com/qigong

node.name: New York English and Mandarin Language Exchange
node.description:
Mandarin and English learners are welcome to join this meetup no matter which country you are from. As a organizer, I strongly encourage that members do their best to speak the language you want to learn to other members.

There are two parts of activities at this meetup:

The majority of activities are held every Thursday nights. Members go to Pret a Manger to have a free talk. The organizer will do his best to make sure you have good partners to practice Mandarin or English. Also, you can move around trying to find good partners who you like to talk to or you are comfortable with.

Because language learners need to have different activities and face different situations so that we can learn different phrases or words, the organizers will also hold other activities. For example, we can learn words about picnic when we go picnic or we can learn words about bowling when we play bowling.

Anyway, please join us and feel relaxed to learn second language!

Please note our RSVP counts usually does not reflect the amount of people coming. A meetup group size of 8-10 is normal for us. See you at the Meetup!!

<br>

node.name: Bengali Reading/Writing Class Meetup
node.description:
Do You Speak Bengali But Want to Learn to Read and Write ?

Did you grow up speaking Bangla but never got in the habit of reading ? If so, this is your chance! We will have fun classes and learning materials, help with typing in Bangla. Classes available in both Jackson Heights and Manhattan. Taught by Mrs. Maya Misra of Kolkata.
Beginning level Bangla classes available also.

Students are asked to pay $15 per class. 

Mayaji graduated with a Bachelor's degree in Philosophy from Scottish Church College of Kolkata. She has received a Nritya Praveen in Kathak dance.
She is the wife of the late Pandit Ramesh Misra and is a Kathak dancer and dance teacher as well.

She has been teaching Bengali to American students for the last eight years. Students taking her classes have praised her classes as "Energetic and enthusiastic" and "We are learning to express ourselves !"
